chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Chapter 1: Entering the Netherworld with Lord Cui
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning dies and enters the Netherworld, where Judge Cui Jue recognizes his karmic merit and arranges his rebirth into the Heavenly path of the Six Paths.
og_title: Desolate Era Ch.1: Judgment in the Netherworld
og_description: After his death, Ji Ning meets Lord Cui Jue, who explains the Six Paths of Reincarnation and grants him a divine Nuwa visualization technique.
twitter_title: Desolate Era - A Soul's Journey in the Netherworld
twitter_description: In this opening chapter, Ji Ning's compassion earns him a place on the Heavenly path, but his true trial begins in his next life.
